item.title: Show HN: Aident Loadout – connect Codex to real apps with 25000 actions
item.summary: Hey HN, I'm Kimi, the founder of Aident. The reason we build Loadout is pretty simple: 1) more than coding, I want more from Codex or Claude Code. I want them to do some real jobs for me. However, without connections to the real tools they need, they'd stop at planning and talking but not shipping the real result. So, we built Loadout so they can find and use the tools they need without configuring APIs, MCPs or CLIs. 2) Then, we realized something even worse: it's a nightmare for me to configure an account for every tool the agents need. I have to register accounts, set up payment, and pay for subscriptions for each tool that agents need. Some of them I might only use once and never again. Loadout comes with a wide range of platform-managed subscriptions so that for those services, no personal SaaS subscriptions needed. I don't need to pay an upfront cost for a subscription but instead I can only pay for usage. For example, saving $200 monthly fee for Ahrefs or $100 subscription for a stock market data service. 3) Lastly, it becomes an even bigger pain in the ass when I want to switch between different harnesses, because I have to configure everything again.
